reddit.title: Explore the New Conquest Mechanics in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share the latest update on our campaign mechanics in Provincia! In Tutorial 2, players will experience a new approach to conquest with five unique territories to explore and conquer. Each territory offers its own rewards and challenges, and the fog of war lifts only as you make progress. Check out the full details on our devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: Introducing Tutorial 2: Conquest in Provincia
